This small plot by the house is my perennial patch — I keep it intercropped so nothing goes to waste on such a tiny piece of land. I do not have cash to spare on chemical fertilizer for this one, especially since the trees and bushes here are not the kind that respond much to urea. What I do is carry manure and kitchen compost from the household to feed the soil, and I handle all the weeding and tending myself. The plot is too small and too close to home to justify hiring anyone.
